info.title: mazz-flux-bot Project API
info.description: Single-user trusted-network API. Existing deployment ingress is the access boundary; do not expose publicly. All project domain writes require expected_revision except create. Delivery status is manual. Only primary is heartbeat-driven. Every removal retains VAPE instances. LaunchDarkly status is read-only; config writes never mutate LD targeting. Settings, files, archetypes, raw instance reads and human-task APIs remain at their existing /api paths.

goal.description: Optional automation direction. May be empty for tracking-only projects; required before automation or new instance provisioning.
Optional automation direction. Empty clears the goal. If no nonblank primary override remains, clearing the last direction pauses heartbeat automation; restoring direction requires explicit Start.

goal_override.description: Primary-only optional direction override. Blank or null falls back to project goal. Clearing the last effective direction pauses heartbeat automation; restoring direction does not resume it.
